name: Carousel
summary: A row of slides shown one (or a few) at a time: a scroll-snap track that a swipe, a trackpad, the arrow keys, the previous and next buttons or the picker moves. Optional peek, loop and autoplay with a visible Pause. Follows the WAI-ARIA APG carousel pattern (tabbed picker). Not for content everyone must see: a carousel hides most of its slides.
a11y: A `region` with `aria-roledescription="carousel"` named by `label`; each slide a `group` with `aria-roledescription="slide"` named "2 of 5" (and its caption). Slides out of view are `inert`. The picker is a `tablist` (one Tab stop, arrows between dots). A polite live region says the new slide when the reader moves it and stays quiet while it rotates by itself. The rotation control comes first and names its action ("Stop slide rotation"). Reduced motion: no smooth scrolling, no autoplay, no fill animation.

keys.keys: Left and Right on the slides
keys.action: previous and next slide (mirrored in right-to-left)

keys.keys: Left and Right in the picker
keys.action: move between dots; Home and End: first and last
scrolls and snaps to a slide

props.name: label
props.description: What the slides are, for the region's name: "Planet scenes", "Featured articles".

props.name: slides
props.description: The slides, in order: pictures with their words, or any content.

props.name: perView
props.description: Slides shown at once: 1 (default) to 4. Narrow containers (under 40 rem) show one.

props.name: peek
props.description: One slide at a time with a part of each neighbour showing, faded and a little smaller; pressing a neighbour brings it to the middle.

props.name: loop
props.description: After the last slide comes the first (and before the first, the last). Off by default: the ends are real.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Moves on by itself every `interval`, with a visible Pause; stops while hovered, stops for good once focus enters or Pause is pressed, and doesn't start when the reader asks for reduced motion. Implies loop.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds per slide while rotating; default the `c.carousel.interval` token (6 s).

props.name: arrows
props.description: Previous and next buttons with the "2 of 5" counter. Default true; without them the picker, a swipe or the arrow keys move it.

props.name: pager
props.description: `dots` (default), `thumbnails` (pictures' thumbnails in a row that scrolls) or `none`.

props.name: index
props.description: The shown slide (first visible one with perView > 1), for a controlled carousel.

props.name: src
props.description: A picture: its source and its words (alt text says what it shows; empty only when the caption already does).

props.name: content
props.description: Any content instead of a picture: a card, a chart, a quote.

props.name: caption
props.description: One line under the slide, read with it.

props.name: label
props.description: A short name for the thumbnails picker and the slide's name when there is no caption ("The pond").
